convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the 'TotalPowerIndicatorX' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator; requires the custom .ex5 indicator file to function and its internal logic is not derivable from standard indicator params

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When Lots parameter is negative, treated as fixed lot size (absolute value); when positive, treated as fraction of free margin for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: Relies on TotalPowerIndicatorX custom indicator buffers to determine bullish/bearish power direction; signal reversal closes opposite position before entry; digit adjustment applied to SL/TP when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (multiply by 10); negative Lots value interpreted as fixed lots, positive as margin fraction
python_conversion_notes: The TotalPowerIndicatorX custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python since it is not a standard indicator. The EA's entry logic depends on this indicator's buffer values crossing a threshold. Without the indicator source, the signal generation logic cannot be fully replicated in Python. Digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers must be preserved in the conversion. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) must be reimplemented with broker-compatible margin calculation.
